name: System Context — E-Commerce
description: C4 Context Diagram (Level 1) provides an overview of the e-commerce system: users, the system being built, and external systems. This is the starting point for any C4 model.
purpose: Define the system scope, main users, and interacting external systems.
bestFor: Presenting high-level architecture to non-technical stakeholders
First step when applying C4 model
useCases: Identify Software System: E-Commerce System (system being built)
Identify External Systems: Payment Gateway, Email Service, SMS Service
Draw relationships between Person and Software System
requirements: REQ-001: Customer can browse products, place orders and make payments
REQ-002: Admin can manage products and orders
REQ-003: System integrates with external Payment Gateway
REQ-004: System sends confirmation emails via Email Service
REQ-005: System sends SMS notifications via SMS Service

elements.name: Customer
elements.description: End user purchasing products on the website
